verdict.rationale: Runpod documents Instant Clusters as fully managed multi-node compute, where you can "deploy jobs" without managing infrastructure, networking, or cluster configuration. That covers the core idea of not building your own cluster on raw nodes. However, nothing in the evidence names Slurm, Kubernetes, or any job scheduler or queue on these clusters. Missing for 10: any evidence of managed Slurm or Kubernetes, job scheduling or queueing semantics on clusters, scheduler docs, and independent corroboration.
